translationRepairs: After the Wei clan's fall, Song Jing, Li Yi, Lu Congyuan, Yao Yuanzhi, Lu Xiangxian, and Lu Huaiqian abolished slanted-seal posts, matched vacancies to candidates, and refused men of high seniority but no real ability.

After the Wei clan's fall, Song Jing, Li Yi, Lu Congyuan, Yao Yuanzhi, Lu Xiangxian, and Lu Huaishen abolished slanted-seal posts, matched vacancies to candidates, and refused men of high seniority but no real ability.
Chinese 盧懷慎 is Lu Huaishen (懷 Huái + 慎 Shèn); Huaiqian misreads 慎. The proposed replacement corrects only that name and leaves the rest of the idiomatic intact.

When the Wei clan fell, Song Jing was first made Minister of Personnel, Li Yi and Lu Congyuan vice ministers, Yao Yuanzhi Minister of War, Lu Xiangxian and Lu Huaiqian vice ministers; all memorialized to abolish slanted-seal officials, measured vacancies and retained men; though seniority was high and examination deep, those without real talent were not taken.
